description: Zustand store selector optimization - Replace broad useAppStore() calls with granular selectors to prevent unnecessary re-renders
steps: In src/app/routes/HomeRoute.tsx: Replace `const { user, tournament, tournamentActions } = useAppStore()` with individual selectors: `const user = useAppStore((s) => s.user)`, `const tournament = useAppStore((s) => s.tournament)`, `const tournamentActions = useAppStore((s) => s.tournamentActions)`. This prevents the component from re-rendering when unrelated state (errors, ui, siteSettings) changes.

In src/shared/components/layout/FloatingNavbar.tsx: Replace `const appStore = useAppStore()` with individual selectors for only the state actually used: `const tournament = useAppStore((s) => s.tournament)`, `const tournamentActions = useAppStore((s) => s.tournamentActions)`, `const user = useAppStore((s) => s.user)`. Remove the `appStore` variable and destructure from the selectors.

In src/shared/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx: Replace `const { tournament, errors, errorActions } = useAppStore()` with individual selectors: `const tournament = useAppStore((s) => s.tournament)`, `const errors = useAppStore((s) => s.errors)`, `const errorActions = useAppStore((s) => s.errorActions)`.
In src/features/tournament/modes/TournamentFlow.tsx: Replace `const { user, tournament, tournamentActions } = useAppStore()` with individual selectors for each piece of state used.

In src/shared/components/profile/ProfileInner.tsx: Replace `const { user } = useAppStore()` with `const user = useAppStore((s) => s.user)`. This is a minor improvement since only user is destructured, but still avoids subscribing to the entire store.
In src/features/dashboard/components/admin/AdminDashboard.tsx: Replace `const { user } = useAppStore()` with `const user = useAppStore((s) => s.user)`.
acceptance_criteria: No component uses useAppStore() without a selector function
All existing tests continue to pass (same pass/fail status as before)
